name: primavera-p6-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Oracle Primavera P6: analyse XER schedule files offline and read or update projects live through the P6 EPPM REST API.

scripts.build:skill: tsc && node build/skill/buildSpec.js ../skill/primavera-p6 && esbuild build/skill/p6.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --legal-comments=none --outfile=../skill/primavera-p6/scripts/p6.mjs && cp ../examples/*.xer ../skill/primavera-p6/examples/ && cd ../skill && rm -f primavera-p6.zip && zip -qr -X primavera-p6.zip primavera-p6

author: C-Kajanan
